as_told.title: Bob Lazar briefed on Project Looking Glass

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at a secret Nevada site in the late 1980s, was briefed on Project Looking Glass, according to Michels, who says it twice in one episode as if it were well known. Project Looking Glass is, in UFO lore, a secret programme; Michels gives no detail of what it did, and cites a man named Timothy Taylor alongside Lazar.
